_comment: KeepMeAlive English text. To translate: copy this file to BepInEx/plugins/KeepMeAlive/Localizations/<code>.json (EFT language code: ru, ge, fr, es, es-mx, it, pl, po, cz, sk, hu, ro, tu, jp, kr, ch), translate the values and keep the keys and {0} placeholders. Missing keys fall back to English. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Counted text (lives) has .One and .Other here; a language that needs more may add .Few (ru: 2-4, 22-24...).
Revive.Disabled: This kind of revive is disabled
Revive.InventoryBusyCanceled: Inventory busy. Revive canceled, try again.
PostRevive.CooldownEnded: Revival cooldown ended - you can now be revived
